name: cotypist
title: Cotypist
description: Read and control Cotypist default completions through its native Accessibility controls
author: itsdanielsultan

commands.name: status
commands.title: Completion Status
commands.description: Read the native default completion setting and available model status

commands.name: enable-default
commands.title: Enable Default Completions
commands.description: Enable completions by default with native state verification

commands.name: disable-default
commands.title: Disable Default Completions
commands.description: Disable completions by default; individually enabled apps retain their overrides

commands.name: toggle-default
commands.title: Toggle Default Completions
commands.description: Toggle the native default completion setting with state verification
